decisions.reason: Having survived the first review, this carpet still fits the firm's existing interiors and materials know-how, so management is more likely to refine and reposition it than withdraw it, though some overlap-driven assortment pruning risk remains.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws strongly on the firm's craftsmanship, premium-material and design capabilities, which supports continued learning and improvement rather than exit.

This low-pile carpet is close enough to the established offer to be supportable with current capabilities, but the firm's broad assortment and prior carpet rationalisation keep the withdrawal risk moderately elevated.

The swivel shell chair line is highly aligned with the firm's core expertise across living and workplace interiors, and the multi-model range gives management room to absorb market feedback and adjust instead of dropping it.
